title: WORKFLOWS
noFolder: Open a folder to use workflows.

detail.loadFailed: The task details could not be loaded.
detail.planApproval: The plan is waiting for your approval. Review it in the latest output below.
detail.question: The agent asks:
detail.truncated: This text is too long; only the first {{size}} KB is shown.

actions.label: Task actions
actions.cancelRunningConfirm: Cancel the running task "{{title}}"? The agent is stopped. If this is the current task of its run, the whole run is cancelled.
actions.markCompleteConfirm: Complete "{{title}}" as if its stage had finished? The workflow continues with the next stage.
actions.revisionPlaceholder: What should change in the plan?
actions.deleteConfirm: Delete the task "{{title}}"? This cannot be undone.

retry.title: Retry the task
retry.description: The task goes back to the inbox and its stage runs again.
retry.acceptScreeningHelp: Only accept it after checking that the task input is safe. The accepted input is not flagged again.
retry.acceptAgentConfigHelp: The changed agent configuration files in the worktree are recorded as reviewed.
retry.acceptIntegrity: Acknowledge the git configuration or hooks changes
retry.acceptIntegrityHelp: A new baseline is taken from the repository as it is now. Branch or HEAD changes alone need no acknowledgement.

merge.label: Merge
merge.previewFailed: The merge preview could not be loaded.
merge.reviewHelp: These files configure tools, CI or agents. Review their changes and tick each one before merging.
merge.integrityHelp: The project's git configuration or hooks changed since the run started. Acknowledge the changes to see the commits and the diff.
merge.recheckConfirm: Acknowledge the repository changes? A new baseline is taken from the repository as it is now. Nothing is merged yet.
merge.mergeConfirm: Merge the branch "{{branch}}" into "{{baseBranch}}" in the project?
merge.removeWorktreeConfirm: Remove the worktree and the branch "{{branch}}"? The merged changes stay in "{{baseBranch}}".
merge.discardConfirm: Discard the run? The worktree and the branch "{{branch}}" will be deleted.

panel.archiveConfirm: Archive the workflow "{{name}}"? No new tasks can be started with it.
panel.deleteConfirm: Delete the workflow "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
panel.activeRuns: Runs in progress: {{count}}. They will continue with their snapshot.
panel.saveFailed: The workflows could not be saved.
panel.addFailed: The workflow could not be added.
panel.runCountFailed: The number of runs in progress could not be checked.
